stories.headline: Meta and Broadcom Expand Partnership to Co-Develop 2nm Custom AI Chips Through 2029

key_facts.fact: Meta and Broadcom announced a multi-year partnership to co-develop multiple generations of MTIA (Meta Training and Inference Accelerator) custom silicon, extending through 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: Broadcom Inc. and Meta today announced a multi-year, multi-generation strategic partnership to support Meta's rapidly scaling artificial intelligence compute infrastructure... with plans to extend through 2029.

key_facts.fact: The initial commitment exceeds 1 gigawatt of custom silicon as the first phase of a sustained, multi-gigawatt rollout, with the partnership rolling out the industry's first 2nm AI compute accelerator.
key_facts.excerpt: Initial commitment exceeds 1GW of custom silicon as phase one of a multi-gigawatt rollout... Partnership will co-develop the industry's first 2nm AI accelerator for Meta's MTIA program.

key_facts.fact: Meta's MTIA chip lineup spans four accelerators optimized for different workloads: MTIA 300 (training, 800W), MTIA 400 (general, 1200W), MTIA 450 (GenAI inference, 1400W), and MTIA 500 (GenAI inference, 1700W with up to 512 GB HBM and 30 PFLOPs MX4).
key_facts.excerpt: MTIA 500: GenAI Inference, Module TDP 1700 W, HBM Bandwidth 27.6 TB/s, HBM Capacity 384-512 GB, MX4 Performance 30 PFLOPs

key_facts.fact: The partnership is built on Broadcom's XPU (custom accelerator) platform, integrating chip design, advanced packaging, and Ethernet networking for scale-up, scale-out, and scale-across connectivity in Meta's AI clusters.
key_facts.excerpt: Broadcom will deliver technology supporting Meta Training and Inference Accelerator (MTIA) chips... Partnership built on Broadcom's industry-leading XPU platform to deeply co-develop and optimize Meta's AI infrastructure across multiple silicon generations.

key_facts.fact: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan, who joined Meta's board in 2024, informed Meta he will not stand for reelection to the board, stepping into an advisor role as the commercial partnership deepens.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta disclosed in a recent filing that Broadcom CEO Hock Tan will not be standing for reelection to Meta's board of directors. Tan, who joined the board in 2024, informed the company of his decision last week.

key_facts.fact: Meta aims for a yearly multi-product cadence to meet its own AI demands and plans to compete directly with commercially available options like Nvidia GPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta has already highlighted that it plans to compete directly with other commercially available options and aims for a yearly multi-product cadence to meet its own demands.

stories.headline: ASML Beats Q1 Estimates With €8.8B Revenue, Raises 2026 Forecast as Chip Demand Outpaces Supply

key_facts.fact: ASML reported Q1 2026 net sales of €8.8 billion ($10.4B), above the €8.5 billion consensus estimate, and net profit of €2.8 billion (EPS €7.15), beating the €2.5 billion estimate.
key_facts.excerpt: Net sales: 8.8 billion euros ($10.4 billion) versus 8.5 billion euros expected. Net profit: 2.8 billion euros versus 2.5 billion euros expected.

key_facts.fact: ASML raised its full-year 2026 revenue forecast to €36–40 billion, up from the prior €34–39 billion range, with gross margin guidance of 51%–53%.
key_facts.excerpt: ASML now expects 2026 total net sales to be between €36 billion and €40 billion, with a gross margin between 51% and 53%

key_facts.fact: Q1 gross margin came in at 53.0%, at the top end of guidance. ASML guided Q2 2026 sales of €8.4–9.0 billion with 51%–52% gross margin.
key_facts.excerpt: Q1 total net sales of €8.8 billion, gross margin of 53.0%, net income of €2.8 billion. ASML expects Q2 2026 total net sales between €8.4 billion and €9.0 billion, and a gross margin between 51% and 52%

key_facts.fact: CEO Christophe Fouquet said chip demand is outpacing supply and customers are accelerating capacity expansion plans for 2026 and beyond. Order intake 'continues to be very strong.'
key_facts.excerpt: "Demand for chips is outpacing supply. In response, our customers are accelerating their capacity expansion plans for 2026 and beyond, supported by long-term agreements with their customers."

key_facts.fact: ASML said it could deliver 60 low-NA EUV tools in 2026 (25% more than 2025) and has capacity to ship 80 in 2027, though Barclays noted 'hopes 90 is possible in 2027' may be disappointed.
key_facts.excerpt: ASML should be able to ship 60 of its flagship low-NA EUV tools in 2026 - 25 per cent more than in 2025 - and will have capacity to ship 80 in 2027.

key_facts.fact: This is the first quarter ASML has not disclosed order numbers, a closely watched metric. ASML shares were flat in early European trade despite the beat, having already risen ~40% year-to-date.
key_facts.excerpt: This is the first quarter where ASML has not disclosed order numbers which is typically a closely-watched metric by investors... ASML shares were flat in early trade in Europe.

stories.headline: Maine Passes First US Statewide Data Center Moratorium, Blocking Projects Over 20 MW

key_facts.fact: Maine's Democrat-controlled legislature passed a moratorium on large data centers, with the House voting 79-62 and the Senate 21-13, largely along party lines. Governor Janet Mills' signature is still needed.
key_facts.excerpt: The state's House passed it 79-62, and the Senate passed it 21-13—along party lines with a few exceptions... Governor Janet Mills' signature is still needed before it becomes law.

key_facts.fact: The bill prohibits local authorities from issuing permits for data centers exceeding 20 MW electrical capacity until November 2027, making Maine the first US state to enact such a measure.
key_facts.excerpt: The Maine law would prohibit local authorities from issuing permits for data centers with electrical capacity exceeding 20 megawatts... becoming the first US state to try and rein in rampant construction driven by the AI race.

key_facts.fact: The 20 MW threshold is relatively low: while early data centers used about 2 MW, the average contemporary data center uses about 40 MW, making this effectively a ban on AI-scale data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: The threshold is 20 megawatts, which is actually pretty low, and effectively blocks construction of what is commonly known as an AI data center. According to the Regional Plan Association... the average contemporary data center uses about 40 megawatts.

key_facts.fact: The bill also creates a council to evaluate the costs and benefits of data centers on Maine residents. Currently, there are no large-scale data centers in the state.
key_facts.excerpt: It also calls for the creation of a council to assess risks and benefits of proposed data centers and provide input for planners. Currently, there are no large-scale data centers in Maine.

key_facts.fact: Maine ranks fourth highest in US electricity prices. A recent Quinnipiac poll found 65% of Americans oppose having a data center built in their community.
key_facts.excerpt: Electric Choice ranks Maine fourth highest in electricity prices.

key_facts.fact: Similar legislative efforts have stalled or failed in Georgia, Maryland, Michigan, New Hampshire, New York, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Vermont, Virginia, and Wisconsin.
key_facts.excerpt: Similar legislative efforts have stalled or failed outright in Georgia, Maryland, Michigan, New Hampshire, New York, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Vermont, Virginia, and Wisconsin.

stories.headline: Microsoft Takes Over OpenAI's Norway Stargate Capacity, Renting 30K Nvidia Vera Rubin Chips

key_facts.fact: Microsoft agreed to rent data center capacity from Nscale at its Narvik, Norway campus in the Arctic Circle, including 30,000 Nvidia Vera Rubin chips. The site was originally planned for OpenAI's Stargate initiative.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft has secured a $6.2 billion agreement to access AI computing capacity in Norway, initially planned for OpenAI, through a partnership with Nscale Global Holdings and Aker ASA.

key_facts.fact: The five-year contract, set to begin in 2026, covers a facility in Kvandal, northern Norway, providing 230 MW initial capacity expandable to 520 MW, powered entirely by renewable hydropower.
key_facts.excerpt: The five-year contract, set to begin in 2026, will utilize a new data center in Kvandal, northern Norway, which will initially provide 230 MW of capacity and has potential to expand to 520 MW... powered entirely by renewable energy, leveraging Norway's abundant hydropower.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI had marketed the Norway site as its first European mega-data center under the 'Stargate Norway' label but could not reach an agreement with Nscale, according to insiders.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI had marketed the project as its first European mega-data center under the label 'Stargate Norway'... OpenAI had negotiated with Nscale for capacity but could not reach agreement, according to insiders.

key_facts.fact: This is at least the second recent pullback for OpenAI's Stargate plans; last week, OpenAI also shelved its Stargate UK project in Britain citing regulatory hurdles and high energy costs.
key_facts.excerpt: Die Aufgabe der Rechenzentrumspläne in Norwegen ist der zweite Dämpfer für OpenAI innerhalb kurzer Zeit. In der vergangenen Woche legte OpenAI sein vergleichbares Rechenzentrumsprojekt Stargate UK in Großbritannien vorerst auf Eis.

key_facts.fact: Nscale has also reportedly found Google as a customer for a separate data center in West London equipped with Nvidia Grace Blackwell chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Nscale hat mit Google einen weiteren Kunden für ein separates, mit Nvidias Grace-Blackwell-Chips ausgestattetes Rechenzentrum in West-London gefunden.

key_facts.fact: The move aligns with Microsoft's broader strategy of securing AI compute through third-party neocloud providers, including a recent $19.4 billion deal with Nebius Group.
key_facts.excerpt: This move aligns with Microsoft's broader strategy to secure AI compute resources through third-party providers, including a recent $19.4 billion deal with Nebius Group.

stories.headline: Credo Acquires Israeli Chip Startup DustPhotonics for Up to $1.3B in Silicon Photonics Push

key_facts.fact: Credo Technology Group agreed to acquire DustPhotonics for $750 million in cash plus approximately 920,000 Credo shares ($123.6M based on closing price), with an additional earnout of up to 3.21 million shares (~$430M) tied to financial milestones, totaling up to ~$1.3 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Israeli chip company DustPhotonics is being acquired by the U.S.-based Credo Technology Group for $750 million in cash and an additional $123 million in shares. The deal also includes a potential earnout of up to 3.2 million additional Credo shares, which... is valued at approximately $430 million.

key_facts.fact: The acquisition gives Credo a vertically integrated connectivity stack spanning SerDes, digital signal processing, silicon photonics, and system integration for AI data center scale-out and scale-up networks, covering 400G, 800G, 1.6T, and roadmap to 3.2T speeds.
key_facts.excerpt: The acquisition will position Credo with a vertically integrated connectivity stack spanning SerDes, Digital Signal Processing (DSP), Silicon Photonics and system integration... DustPhotonics has developed a differentiated portfolio of SiPho PICs spanning 400G, 800G, and 1.6T, with a roadmap extending to 3.2T.

key_facts.fact: DustPhotonics Chairman Avigdor Willenz previously sold Habana Labs to Intel and Annapurna Labs to AWS. The company raised over $100 million from investors including Greenfield Partners, Sienna Venture Capital, Exor Ventures, and Atreides Management.
key_facts.excerpt: DustPhotonics Chairman Avigdor Willenz previously sold Habana Labs to Intel and Annapurna Labs to AWS. Since its founding, the company has raised over $100 million.

key_facts.fact: Credo expects its combined optical product portfolio to generate more than $500 million in optical revenue in fiscal year 2027. The SiPho PIC market is estimated to grow to $6 billion by 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: The company expects its combined portfolio of ZeroFlap Optical Transceivers, Optical DSPs, and Silicon Photonics products to generate greater than $500 million in optical revenue in fiscal 2027... the SiPho PIC market is expected to grow to $6 billion by 2030.

key_facts.fact: Credo shares surged roughly 17% on the news. The deal is expected to close in Q2 2026 and be accretive to non-GAAP EPS in fiscal 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: CRDO shares are trading higher Tuesday after the company announced it will acquire DustPhotonics... The company expects the transaction to be accretive to non-GAAP earnings per share in fiscal 2027.

stories.headline: Nvidia Releases Ising, First Open-Source AI Models for Quantum Error Correction and Calibration

key_facts.fact: Nvidia released Ising, which it calls the world's first family of open AI models for quantum computing, targeting two key bottlenecks: quantum processor calibration and quantum error correction decoding.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia Corp. today announced the release of Ising, the world's first open artificial intelligence model family aimed at quantum computing calibration and error correction.

key_facts.fact: Ising Decoding offers two 3D convolutional neural network models (912K and 1.79M parameters) that provide up to 2.5x faster speed and up to 3x more accuracy than PyMatching, the current open-source industry standard.
key_facts.excerpt: These models are tiny, coming in at 912,000 parameters for Ising-Decoder-SurfaceCode-1 and 1.79 million for the larger 'Accurate' model, allowing them to catch errors between 2.25 and 2.5x faster than conventional approaches using frameworks like PyMatching.

key_facts.fact: Ising Calibration is a 35-billion-parameter vision-language model that can be integrated into an agentic framework to fully automate quantum processor bring-up and calibration workflows.
key_facts.excerpt: The GPU giant says the 35 billion-parameter vision-language model was trained on data generated by partner systems, to help developers dial in the ideal settings to minimize noise within the systems.

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang said: 'AI is essential to making quantum computing practical. With Ising, AI becomes the control plane — the operating system of quantum machines.'
key_facts.excerpt: "AI is essential to making quantum computing practical," founder and Chief Executive Jensen Huang said. "With Ising, AI becomes the control plane — the operating system of quantum machines."

key_facts.fact: Early adopters include Fermilab, Harvard University, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, the UK National Physical Laboratory, and quantum companies Infleqtion and IQM Quantum Computers.
key_facts.excerpt: Top academic and research institutions, including Fermilab, Harvard University, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory Quantum Testbed, and the UK National Physical Laboratory, as well as quantum technology companies such as Infleqtion and IQM Quantum Computers, have announced their adoption.

key_facts.fact: Weights are available on Hugging Face, with Ising Calibration 1 also available as an Nvidia NIM inference microservice. The calibration model outperformed Gemini 3.1 Pro by 3.27% and Claude Opus 4.6 by 9.68% on quantum calibration benchmarks.
key_facts.excerpt: Ising Calibration 1 is 3.27% better than Gemini 3.1 Pro, 9.68% better than Claude Opus 4.6, and 14.5% better than GPT 5.4.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind Launches Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 With Enhanced Spatial Reasoning for Robots

key_facts.fact: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6, a reasoning model for robots that significantly improves spatial reasoning, multi-view understanding, and introduces instrument reading capability for industrial gauges and sight glasses.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we're introducing Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6, a significant upgrade to our reasoning-first model that enables robots to understand their environments with unprecedented precision. By enhancing spatial reasoning and multi-view understanding...

key_facts.fact: The model shows significant improvement over both Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5 and Gemini 3.0 Flash in spatial and physical reasoning tasks including pointing, counting, and success detection.
key_facts.excerpt: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 shows significant improvement over both Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5 and Gemini 3.0 Flash, specifically enhancing spatial and physical reasoning capabilities such as pointing, counting, and success detection.

key_facts.fact: Boston Dynamics has integrated ER 1.6 into its Orbit AIVI-Learning product, allowing its Spot robot to autonomously patrol industrial sites and read instruments like pressure gauges. The integration has been available since April 8.
key_facts.excerpt: Boston Dynamics has integrated Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 into its Orbit AIVI-Learning product, allowing the Spot robot to autonomously patrol industrial sites and read data from instruments like pressure gauges. This integration, available since April 8.

key_facts.fact: The model can natively call tools like Google Search, vision-language-action models (VLAs), or any third-party user-defined functions, acting as the high-level reasoning layer for a robot.
key_facts.excerpt: This model specializes in reasoning capabilities critical for robotics... capable of executing tasks by natively calling tools like Google Search to find information, vision-language-action models (VLAs) or any other third-party user-defined functions.

key_facts.fact: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 is described as DeepMind's safest robotics model to date, with superior compliance in safety instruction and risk identification tests. It is available via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepMind highlights ER 1.6 as its safest model, with superior compliance in safety instruction and risk identification tests compared to previous models.
